title.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash统一三种模式
title.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash Unifies Three Modes

excerpt.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 计划于2026年9月10日前后发布，统一快速、专家与识图模式，并将于9月14日接替V4 Pro；价格与迁移安排值得关注。

text.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash：统一入口
text.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash: A Unified Entry Point

text.zh: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 计划于北京时间2026年9月10日前后发布，核心变化是把快速模式、专家模式和识图模式合并为一个统一的智能模式。对用户而言，重点不再是选择不同入口，而是让系统根据问题复杂度和输入形式自动决定处理方式。
text.en: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash is planned for release around Sept. 10, 2026 Beijing time. Its central change is the combination of fast, expert, and vision modes into one intelligent mode. Instead of choosing among separate entry points, users will rely on the system to determine the processing approach from query complexity and input type.

text.zh: 这一调整主要针对交互流程。系统据称会自动检测查询难度，在发现图片输入时启用视觉能力，并根据任务要求调整处理能力。它并不意味着所有请求都会以同样的资源规模运行，而是试图把模式选择从用户操作转移到模型或平台内部。
text.en: The change is primarily about interaction flow. According to the source, the system can detect task difficulty, activate visual capabilities when images are present, and adjust its processing effort to the request. This does not mean every prompt will use the same level of resources; it shifts mode selection from the user interface to the model or platform.

text.zh: V4.1 Flash的发布与迁移安排
text.en: Release and Migration Plans for V4.1 Flash

text.zh: DeepSeek称，V4.1 Flash在内部和外部测试的性能、费用、速度及总用时指标上都超过V4 Pro。现有信息来自发布预告和官方交流群通知，因此这些结论应理解为厂商公布的测试判断，而不是已经披露完整方法、数据集和独立复核结果的公开基准。
text.en: DeepSeek says that V4.1 Flash outperformed V4 Pro in performance, cost, speed, and total completion time across internal and external testing. The available information comes from a release preview and a notice shared in an official group, so these claims should be read as the company’s testing assessment rather than as a fully documented, independently verified benchmark.

text.zh: 平台计划在北京时间9月14日12:00下线V4 Pro服务。届时，原本指向V4 Pro的请求将被路由到V4.1 Flash，并按照V4.1 Flash的价格计费。对依赖固定模型名称的应用来说，真正需要关注的是这一变化是否会影响输出风格、延迟、预算和回归测试结果。
text.en: The platform plans to retire the V4 Pro service at 12:00 Beijing time on Sept. 14. Requests that previously targeted V4 Pro will then be routed to V4.1 Flash and billed at V4.1 Flash rates. Applications that depend on a fixed model name should watch for possible changes in output style, latency, budget, and regression-test results.

text.zh: 多模态能力、API与价格变化
text.en: Multimodal Capabilities, APIs, and Pricing

text.zh: 在V4.1 Flash之前，DeepSeek API平台已经上线DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp多模态视觉理解模型，并支持Chat Completions、Messages和Responses三种调用格式。结合统一智能模式的描述，开发者可能获得更简化的模型调用路径，但来源没有说明新模型最终会以哪些API名称、参数或兼容性规则正式提供。
text.en: Before V4.1 Flash, the DeepSeek API platform had already made the DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp multimodal vision model available, with support for Chat Completions, Messages, and Responses formats. The unified-mode design could simplify model routing for developers, but the source does not specify the final API names, parameters, or compatibility rules for the new model.

text.zh: Flash系列还将调整价格。自9月10日12:00起，空闲时段的输入缓存命中价格为每单位0.02元，输入缓存未命中为1元，输出为4元；高峰时段按空闲时段价格的两倍计算。实际成本仍取决于缓存命中率、输入输出规模以及业务高峰分布，不能只看单项价格。
text.en: The Flash series will also receive a pricing adjustment. From 12:00 on Sept. 10, the off-peak rates are listed as 0.02 yuan per unit for cache-hit input, 1 yuan for cache-miss input, and 4 yuan for output; peak-period prices are twice the off-peak rates. Actual spending will still depend on cache-hit rates, input and output volume, and traffic distribution.

text.zh: 应用影响与仍待确认的问题
text.en: Practical Impact and Open Questions

text.zh: 对普通用户，统一模式可能减少手动试错，让文字和图片任务使用同一入口。对开发团队，模型下线和自动路由则意味着需要检查模型标识、账单规则、提示词表现及视觉输入处理。尤其是对结果稳定性要求较高的工作流，迁移前后进行小规模对照测试仍然必要。
text.en: For general users, a unified mode may reduce manual trial and error by providing one entry point for text and image tasks. For development teams, retirement and automatic routing mean checking model identifiers, billing rules, prompt behavior, and image-input handling. Workflows that require stable outputs should still run controlled comparisons before and after migration.

text.zh: 目前尚不清楚V4.1 Flash的正式发布时间是否会精确落在预告窗口内，也不清楚“全面超越”所覆盖的具体任务和测试条件。来源同样没有给出详细技术规格、上下文限制或迁移指南。因而，用户可以据此准备切换和成本评估，但不宜把宣传性结论直接等同于所有场景中的确定优势。
text.en: It remains unclear whether the final release will occur exactly within the announced window, or which tasks and test conditions are covered by the claim of broad superiority. The source also provides no detailed technical specifications, context limits, or migration guide. Users can prepare for routing and cost changes, but should not treat promotional conclusions as guaranteed advantages in every workload.

text.zh: 结论：从模式选择转向自动路由
text.en: Conclusion: From Mode Selection to Automatic Routing

text.zh: 这次更新的重点不只是推出一个更快的Flash版本，而是把模型选择、视觉触发和资源调度整合进统一体验。若发布时间、性能和价格安排按计划落地，DeepSeek用户将面对更少的模式切换，同时也需要适应V4 Pro下线后的行为和计费变化。最终价值仍要由正式文档、实际调用表现和不同业务的成本数据共同验证。
text.en: The significance of this update is not limited to launching a faster Flash variant. It combines model selection, vision activation, and resource allocation into a single experience. If the release, performance, and pricing plans proceed as announced, users will switch modes less often but will need to account for behavioral and billing changes after V4 Pro’s retirement. The practical value will ultimately depend on official documentation, live request behavior, and workload-specific cost data.
